name: Engineering Deck
narrativeOnEnter: Cramped and hot. Conduit panels cover every wall. The main junction box hangs open — someone started the reroute and stopped. A wiring schematic is taped inside the panel cover. Below, an access tunnel leads to the cargo bay and reactor.

action.text:
LIFE SUPPORT POWER REROUTE — ENGINEERING MANUAL
Taped inside panel cover — DO NOT REMOVE

Emergency connection order:
  Red   → Junction A  (High voltage — connect first)
  Blue  → Junction D
  Green → Junction B
  Yellow→ Junction C  (Low voltage — connect last)

Incorrect wiring will trip the breaker and count as a system fault.
Complete sequence restores life support and unseals command blast doors.

ENGINEERING LOG — KOVALEV, D.
Entry 112

'Reactor temperature readings are off by 40%. Started the wiring reroute but had to abort — reactor alarm triggered while I was mid-sequence.

Gone to Reactor Deck to manually stabilise. If anyone finds this:
— Finish the wiring first (schematic is on the panel)
— Cargo Bay lock sequence is on the freight manifest
— Reactor stabilisation sequence is in the safety manual on Reactor Deck

If I don't make it back, pod bay code is on Chen's ID.'
